description: This file defines the Currency class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling currency formatting, conversion, and retrieval of currency data from a database.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class to manage currencies, including formatting, conversion, and retrieval of currency details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Currency object, loads currency data from the database.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string based on currency settings.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a monetary value from one currency to another.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a specified currency.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Returns the left symbol for a given currency.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Returns the right symbol for a given currency.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Retrieves the number of decimal places for a currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the conversion value of a currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a currency exists in the loaded currencies.
